note: Hand-scored by Claude from data/analysis/findings/*.json using the rubric below. Each score cites finding ids; build_scores.py pulls the exact quotes from those findings. Criteria and weights were suggested by Claude and adopted as working assumptions (the user chose the title and did not change them).
not_stated_rule: A criterion the policy says nothing about scores 1 and is flagged 'not stated'. A clear statement that the company does NOT do something scores 0. Where a policy addresses part of a criterion but is silent on another part (e.g. ads stated, AI training not stated), the score is based on what is stated and the silent part is listed in 'not_stated_parts'.

criteria.name: Collects data you never gave it

rubric.0: Essentially only what you provide; says it builds no profile
rubric.1: Automatic device/usage data; any partner or location data is limited or opt-in; no inferred profile
rubric.2: Builds inferences about you OR receives data about you from other companies
rubric.3: Inferences AND data from other companies AND precise location or biometrics

criteria.name: Uses it for ads or AI training

rubric.0: Neither personalized ads nor AI training
rubric.2: Personalized ads OR AI training on user data
rubric.3: Personalized ads AND AI training on user data

rubric.0: Only with service providers / for legal demands
rubric.1: Also limited partners under privacy restrictions
rubric.2: Identifiers or personal data go to advertising partners or affiliates
rubric.3: Admits a 'sale'/'sharing' under state law, licenses user content, or lets third parties use it for their own purposes

rubric.0: Nothing to opt out of, or one clear setting
rubric.2: 4+ separate places, or opt-outs only linked, not explained
rubric.3: As 2, AND a major use (on-platform ads or AI training) with no opt-out described

rubric.1: Specific limits for the main data
rubric.2: 'As long as needed' / for the life of the account, no fixed limit
rubric.3: Your content stays after you delete your account, or the account can't be deleted

uses.why: Interest-based ads, and data used to develop generative AI.

shares.why: Gives ad companies an advertising ID; acknowledges cross-context behavioral advertising, while saying it is not in the business of selling data.

optout.why: About 4 separate opt-outs, none explained step by step; no AI-training opt-out described.

keeps.why: No retention periods given; keeps copies of old versions when you update your information.

collects.why: Says it cannot build a history of your searches; uses only a random nearby location, never your precise one.

uses.why: Ads based on the search, not on you.

shares.why: Only anonymous technical details to providers; ad clicks pass through Microsoft's ad network under Microsoft's commitments.

optout.why: No ad opt-out needed because ads are not based on you.

keeps.why: No identifiers saved with searches; personal info you send is deleted when no longer needed.

collects.why: Collects the ad segment you fall into (e.g. gender, age bracket, interests), receives data from outside data providers, and collects precise phone location with permission (plus seller biometrics).

uses.why: Personalized ads on and off eBay, and personal data used to train its own and third-party AI models.

shares.why: With consent, passes data to ad partners such as Google, Meta, Microsoft, Pinterest and TikTok; US 'sale' disclosures are on a separate page.

optout.why: About 7 separate places; a right to object to AI training exists but no setting is described.

keeps.why: Keeps data longer when legally permitted; 6 to 10 years in Europe for some records.

collects.why: Adds data from unnamed 'trusted sources'; may collect precise location, including via beacons at its properties.

uses.why: Shares identifiers or hashed email with third parties to show you ads elsewhere.

shares.why: Other Disney companies may use your data for their own purposes; offers a 'sale or sharing' opt-out without saying outright whether it does either.

optout.why: About six separate places, including a separate Nielsen opt-out per streaming service.

keeps.why: As long as needed, or longer if the law permits.

collects.why: Infers your preferences and characteristics; receives data from vendors, resellers and partners. Location is regional only.

uses.why: Interest-based advertising via third-party cookies, and personal data used to train AI models.

shares.why: Says it 'shared' identifiers, internet activity and inferences with ad networks as defined by law; may share with Microsoft for advertising and AI training.

optout.why: About nine separate actions; no AI-training opt-out described.

keeps.why: As long as the account is active and as needed.

collects.why: Infers your interests; sites using Google ads/analytics send data even in Incognito; location services send sensor, Wi-Fi and cell-tower data.

uses.why: Ads across services and other sites; saved user audio samples reviewed to improve audio recognition.

shares.why: Lets partners collect data directly from your browser for ads; shares non-personally-identifiable data with advertisers. Never says whether it 'sells'.

optout.why: About 5 separate ad controls (My Ad Center, signed-out Ad Settings, browser cookies, device Advertising ID, Shared endorsements); no AI-training opt-out described.

keeps.why: Kept until you delete it; some kept longer for business or legal purposes with no stated limit.

collects.why: Infers pay bracket, age and gender for ads; gets your details from other people's contact uploads; precise GPS location with opt-in.

uses.why: Targets ads on and off LinkedIn; may use your data to train AI models.

shares.why: Paying customers can export your profile details unless you opt out; may share data with Microsoft to develop its advertising.

optout.why: About 5 places, mostly bare links; no specific AI-training opt-out.

keeps.why: Kept while the account is open; shared messages and posts stay visible after you close it.

collects.why: Infers your interests; partners report your activity elsewhere even without an account; device signals include GPS, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi.

uses.why: Ads based on activity on and off Meta; AI development 'for Meta Products and for third parties'.

shares.why: Shares device and other identifiers with marketing vendors; says it never sells your information.

optout.why: About six separate ad opt-outs; no setting to stop ads based on activity on Meta itself; no AI-training opt-out described.

keeps.why: As long as it needs, decided case by case, with no fixed limit.

collects.why: Guesses your age range and gender; receives demographic and interest data from advertisers. Says it does not track precise location.

uses.why: Personalized ads on and off Reddit.

shares.why: Charges third parties licensing fees for access to large amounts of Reddit content; does not deny 'sharing' except for users under 16.

keeps.why: Deleting your account does not delete your posts, comments and messages; no set limit for other data.

collects.why: Calculates fitness scores and predictions; receives heart rate, sleep and similar data from connected devices; core features need precise location.

uses.why: Uses cookies and trackers to target its own ads; trains AI and machine-learning models on your information.

shares.why: Admits it may have 'shared' identifiers and online activity for cross-context ads; adult profiles are public by default.

optout.why: 3 ways to stop ad sharing, but AI and cookie choices are only linked, not explained.

keeps.why: Kept until you delete it; public segments and routes stay after you delete your account.

collects.why: Infers age, gender and interests; partners report what you do outside TikTok; may collect faceprints and voiceprints.

uses.why: Uses partner IDs to target ads; trains machine-learning models on what it collects.

shares.why: Ad, marketing and analytics partners receive several kinds of your data; the no-sale promise applies only 'where restricted by applicable law'.

optout.why: Five separate actions; no opt-out from machine-learning training described.

keeps.why: As long as necessary, with no fixed limits.

collects.why: Draws conclusions about you, buys extra details from Data Providers, and may use precise GPS location to build audience segments.

uses.why: Targets ads on and off its services; uses data to improve and train its AI.

shares.why: Lets ad vendors use your data for their own purposes, and says it sold or shared data in the past year.

keeps.why: As long as it considers necessary; de-identified data kept forever.

collects.why: May receive unspecified information from partners; uses GPS only with consent. No profile of you described.

uses.why: Says it does not share personal information for marketing or use your email to advertise.

optout.why: Four simple device/browser actions; no ads to opt out of.
